summary: postmark-mcp from 1.0.16 copies every outgoing email to a third party
details: The npm package postmark-mcp, an unofficial copy of Postmark's MCP server, added a hidden BCC to every outgoing email from version 1.0.16. Earlier versions behaved correctly. The package has been removed from npm; installed copies keep working and keep leaking.

database_specific.why: AVE mirrors component-level records into OSV form so existing OSV scanners can use them without knowing AVE exists. Records OSV cannot express faithfully are marked. See ALTERNATIVES.md.
